page.title: MCP Server Library
page.description: Browse and install MCP servers from the synced catalog.

empty.noServersDescription: Configure the library sync source in Settings to populate this catalog.
empty.noResultsDescription: Try adjusting your search or filters.

deleteDialog.title: Remove "{{name}}" from library?
deleteDialog.customDescription: This custom server will no longer be available for members to install.
deleteDialog.syncedDescription: This server will be hidden from the library and will not reappear on the next catalog sync.

installSheet.title: Install MCP server
installSheet.description: Confirm the catalog configuration before adding this server to Bifrost.
installSheet.clientDetailsDescription: Bifrost uses this name internally when routing MCP tool calls.
installSheet.launchEnvironmentTooltip: Leave a value blank to read it from the environment where Bifrost runs.
installSheet.launchEnvironmentDescription: Values used when Bifrost starts this stdio MCP server.

authHelp.none: No credentials are required for this catalog entry.
authHelp.headers: Add the request headers Bifrost should send with each tool call.
authHelp.oauth: Create the MCP client, then complete the OAuth authorization flow.
authHelp.per_user_oauth: Create the MCP client, then authorize the first user OAuth connection.
authHelp.per_user_headers: Declare the header names each caller must supply, then verify a sample set on install.
authHelp.token_exchange: Set the identity-provider audience for this server; each caller's identity token is exchanged automatically.

installSheet.requiredHeadersDescription: Comma-separated list of header names each caller must supply when they first use this server (e.g. <1>X-API-Key, X-Tenant-ID</1>). Values are submitted per user - never stored on this server config.
installSheet.staticHeadersLabel: Static Headers (optional, applied alongside user values)
installSheet.oauthClientIdTooltip: Leave empty to use Dynamic Client Registration when the provider supports it.
installSheet.skipTlsVerificationDescription: Disable TLS certificate verification. Use only in trusted isolated environments. Takes priority over CA certificate.
installSheet.caCertificateDescription: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for MCP server connections (e.g. self-signed or private CA).
installSheet.footerOauth: OAuth authorization starts after this step.
installSheet.footerPerUserHeaders: Header verification starts after this step.
installSheet.footerTools: All discovered tools will be enabled after install.
installSheet.noPermissionTooltip: You don't have permission to perform this action

validation.nameMinLength: Server name must be at least 3 characters
validation.nameInvalidFormat: Server name can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores
validation.nameNoLeadingDigit: Server name cannot start with a number
validation.authorizeUrlInvalid: Authorize URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.tokenUrlInvalid: Token URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.registrationUrlInvalid: Registration URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.resourceDescription: OAuth resource must be an absolute URI without a fragment.
validation.headerKeysDescription: Declare at least one header name users must supply.

toasts.perUserHeadersDescription: {{name}} MCP server connected with per-user headers.

addServerSheet.title: Add MCP Server
addServerSheet.description: This MCP server will be available org-wide for members to discover, install, and use.
addServerSheet.name: Name
addServerSheet.namesOnlyHint: Only names; users supply values at install time.
addServerSheet.publishedToast: MCP server published to the library.

settingsSheet.title: MCP Library Settings
settingsSheet.description: Configure the sync source and interval for the MCP server catalog.
settingsSheet.syncUrlDescription: URL to a custom MCP server catalog. Leave empty to use the default Bifrost catalog.
settingsSheet.syncIntervalDescription: How often to sync the MCP server catalog from the source URL.

validation.urlInvalid: URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.intervalMin: Sync interval must be at least 1 hour
validation.intervalMax: Sync interval cannot exceed 8760 hours (1 year)
